### Highlights | 更新内容

- 设置页的「返回」按钮和 `Esc` 现在都能退出设置页。此前点返回不会有任何反应，只能用 `Command+W` 或关掉窗口才能离开。
  The back control and `Esc` now leave the settings page. Pressing back did nothing at all before, so the only ways out were `Command+W` or closing the window.

### Maintenance | 维护更新

- 渲染探针原先是直接请 presenter 关闭页面来验证退出，这个断言在坏掉的构建上同样成立，因此缺陷一路绿灯。探针现在改为在无障碍树里找到返回控件并按压它，只要页面仍算呈现、仍挂在窗口上、仍占着键盘或仍占着标题就拒绝发布，并用三条 fixture 覆盖这个形状。
  The render probe used to verify the exit by asking the presenter to close the page -- a claim that also held on the broken build, so the defect stayed green. It now finds the control in the accessibility tree and presses it, refusing any press that leaves the page presented, mounted, holding the keyboard, or holding the title, with three fixtures carrying that shape.
- 全量约束审计保持 0 失败，105 条变异全部捕获。
  The full constraint audit stays at zero failures with 105 of 105 mutations caught.
